CREATE TABLE "public"."accounts" (
  "access_token" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "password" text,
  "profile_raw" jsonb,
  "provider_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "accounts_type_check_2f22e716" CHECK ("type" IN ('LOCAL', 'GOOGLE', 'APPLE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "changes" jsonb,
  "controller" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration_ms" int4 NOT NULL,
  "error_message" text,
  "handler" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "request_body" jsonb,
  "request_headers" jsonb,
  "request_id" text NOT NULL,
  "request_params" jsonb,
  "request_query" jsonb,
  "response_body" jsonb,
  "role_code" text,
  "route" text,
  "status_code" int4 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "extract_quality" text,
  "extracted_key" text,
  "failure_reason" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "media_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "page_count" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rewrite_mode" text NOT NULL,
  "source_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL,
  "storage_prefix" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "total_chars" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "total_duration_ms" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_extract_quality_check_34bdf103" CHECK ("extract_quality" IN ('OK', 'LOW')),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_rewrite_mode_check_74da5c5e" CHECK ("rewrite_mode" IN ('RAW', 'FLUENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_status_check_30cbb25c" CHECK ("status" IN ('QUEUED', 'EXTRACTING', 'SCRIPTING', 'SYNTHESIZING', 'READY', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."job_executions" (
  "affected_rows" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration" int4,
  "end_time" timestamptz,
  "error_message" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "job_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "retry_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "start_time" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "job_executions_status_check_65f4a11e" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'TIMEOUT', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."jobs" (
  "category" text DEFAULT 'MAINTENANCE' NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "consecutive_failures" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cron_pattern" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "last_execution_at" timestamptz,
  "last_failure_at" timestamptz,
  "last_success_at" timestamptz,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "params" jsonb,
  "retry_limit" int4 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "jobs_category_check_8228a3ae" CHECK ("category" IN ('MAINTENANCE', 'NOTIFICATION', 'DATA_SYNC', 'CLEANUP', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."llm_usage" (
  "cache_read_tokens" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "cache_write_tokens" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "cost_usd" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_id" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "input_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "output_tokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "section_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration" int4,
  "file_name" text NOT NULL,
  "height" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "mime_type" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "storage_key" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "uploader_id" int4,
  "width" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification_templates" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "params" text[] NOT NULL,
  "subject" text NOT NULL,
  "template" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_templates_channel_check_96614c37" CHECK ("channel" IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS', 'PUSH')),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_templates_params_elem_not_null_88a787ca" CHECK (array_position("params", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "actions" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "actor_id" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" int4,
  "entity_type" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "recipient_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_entity_type_check_7aa73585" CHECK ("entity_type" IN ('Document')),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_db261f90" CHECK ("type" IN ('PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN', 'DOCUMENT_READY', 'DOCUMENT_FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permissions" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "module" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."playback_progress" (
  "completed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "position_ms" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "section_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."push_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "push_tokens_platform_check_120bc35e" CHECK ("platform" IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."revenuecat_events" (
  "app_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role_permissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "permission_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "role_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_super" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "is_system" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "rank" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sections" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "audio_key" text,
  "char_count" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "duration_ms" int4,
  "failure_reason" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "model" text,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "page_end" int4,
  "page_start" int4,
  "prompt_version" text,
  "script" jsonb,
  "script_hash" text,
  "size_bytes" int4,
  "source_text" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sections_status_check_43b86a93" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SCRIPTING', 'SCRIPTED', 'SYNTHESIZING', 'READY', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscriptions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_period_end" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_event_at" timestamptz,
  "plan" text DEFAULT 'FREE' NOT NULL,
  "product_id" text,
  "rc_app_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "store" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_plan_check_11a46379" CHECK ("plan" IN ('FREE', 'PRO')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_status_check_0c2daa37" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'GRACE', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_store_check_7b73277d" CHECK ("store" IN ('APP_STORE', 'PLAY_STORE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usage_ledger" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_id" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "pages" int4 NOT NULL,
  "period_key" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_consents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "granted" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_consents_type_check_2eb1bc97" CHECK ("type" IN ('PRIVACY_NOTICE', 'TERMS_OF_USE', 'CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "bio" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_email_verified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamptz,
  "last_login_method" text,
  "name" text,
  "role_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "surname" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_last_login_method_check_379e5f3a" CHECK ("last_login_method" IN ('LOCAL', 'GOOGLE', 'APPLE')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_7c5ddd00" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "token" character(48) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "verification_tokens_type_check_5a4470d6" CHECK ("type" IN ('EMAIL_VERIFICATION', 'PASSWORD_RESET'))
)
